project: Cosmic Chaos: A vibe-coded web game made of random bs
readme: Source of truth for tooling. Do not add, remove or bump a dependency without editing this file and package.json in the same change, then run npm run verify:harness.

runtime.rendering: Canvas 2D only. No WebGL, no WebGPU, so CI never needs a GPU.
runtime.audio: Native Web Audio API, all sounds synthesized at runtime. No audio files.
runtime.randomness: Seeded Mulberry32 implemented in src/util/rng.ts. No library.
runtime.timestep: Fixed 60 Hz simulation step, rendering interpolates.
runtime.state: Stateless. No database, no localStorage, no sessionStorage, no IndexedDB, no cookies, no network at runtime beyond loading static files.

tooling.unitAndSpec: vitest (node environment, hand-written fake canvas context, no native canvas module)

pinNotes.typescript: Held on 6.0.x because typescript-eslint 8.71.x declares support for TypeScript below 6.1.

gate.note: Playwright Chromium, the Chrome engine, pinned by the Playwright version.

matrix.rule: The after jobs start only when the gate job passes.

headless.unitAndCross: Run in Node against a hand-written fake CanvasRenderingContext2D that records draw calls. No display, no GPU, no native modules.
headless.e2eAndApi: Playwright headless against the built bundle served by vite preview. Canvas 2D renders in software.
headless.audio: Game code talks to an AudioPort. Tests use a recording backend. The real AudioContext is created lazily on the first user gesture, which also avoids the autoplay console warning.

ci.zeroWarnings: Vitest setup (tests/setup/fail-on-console.ts) and the Playwright fixture (tests/e2e/fixtures.ts) fail on any console warning or error, uncaught page error, or failed request. index.html must declare a favicon to avoid a 404 error.

viewport.behavior: Contain-fit with letterboxing or pillarboxing, image-rendering: pixelated, integer upscaling preferred when it keeps at least 90 percent of the fit size.

inputs: Virtual touch D-pad for coarse pointers and mobile viewports
forbidden: Any git command or edit inside .git
Audio files (wav, mp3, ogg, m4a, flac)
Math.random, Date.now and performance.now outside src/app/clock.ts and tests
WebGL, WebGPU, localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, cookies, WebSocket
